hooks.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.tool_input.command | test("gh pr create")' >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; npx tsc --noEmit && npm test
hooks.statusMessage: Quality gate: tsc + unit tests (screenshots run in CI / on dev-builder)...

hooks.command: jq -r 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("git push")) then {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"QUALITY GATE: You just pushed to git. Run through this checklist NOW — do not tell the user the work is done until every item is checked: (1) npx tsc --noEmit — must be clean. (2) pnpm test — all passing. (3) Screenshots — never on the Mac (baselines are Linux renders): npm run test:screenshots:remote on dev-builder, or trust the Screenshot Tests CI job on the PR. (4) pnpm build — clean build. (5) README.md / docs/ — MANDATORY: re-read every README section that touches the changed feature and update any stale copy; if the feature is new to users, add it. This step is not optional and is frequently skipped — do it explicitly. (6) Screenshots regenerated (npm run test:screenshots:remote:update) if any UI changed. (7) Do NOT merge locally — push branch, open PR."}} | tojson else empty end'
